headline: US stocks climb to their best day since the Iran war began after oil prices ease
summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 387 points, or 0.8%, and the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.2% as a drop in oil prices lifted the market on Monday.
why: The Dow and Nasdaq are the main benchmark indexes for large US companies, so their moves signal broad investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Dow Jones Industrial Average
impacts.why: The index gained 0.8% in the session, driven by lower oil prices.
